title: Saving documents in Draft Mode
text:
Saving documents in Draft Mode 
 N avigation in Farvision 
 Saving documents in draft mode 
 Draft mode allows users to temporarily save typed data without storing the data in the actual transactional database. Large transactions can be saved in interim state as Draft mode for future use. User can resume re-entry of transactions from draft mode. 
 Transactions within draft mode are not available for any further subsequent processing. Draft Mode has to be set as ‘ON’ in the interface for Draft mode saving button to be enabled. There is no such setting required for Draft mode enabling. It is enabled by code only. 
 ‘Save As Draft’ is enabled under submit menu. 
 After a document is saved as draft, user can only retrieve it again after making draft mode on in the same interface. 
 Click on the row to open the screen and make further entry or necessary changes. After that user is required to finally submit and save the entry.

title: Print
text:
Print 
 N avigation in Farvision 
 Print 
 Printing of documents can be done only once the documents are saved. Only a single document can be printed. Through the Advanced Search option, bulk printing can be done. 
 For some type of entry, multiple documents can be tagged for printing. Example, for each Tax Invoice printed, a Statement of Accounts can be automatically printed along with the tax invoice. 
 For each entry type, i.e. transaction forms like money receipt, purchase order, invoice formats which are set as default, will automatically be shown. Different default formats can be setup for Business Units and type of documents too. 
 Single and Bulk document printing 
 A single document can be printed only once the document is saved. Only the saved document can be printed. A range of document numbers cannot be selected for printing. The Print Dialogue Box will open from where document will be sent for printing. 
 Once click on Print, it will display all set formats 
 Bulk printing of documents can be done from Advanced Search option. The documents which are to be printed are selected and Print button is clicked as shown below. 
 Printing of multiple different formats for each document 
 For some documents, as listed below, more than one different format can be printed for each document. All the formats which are tagged will be printed sequentially for each document, and then the process will be repeated for the second document numbering. Example, with each Booking, a Welcome letter will be sent along with the booking details, Statement of Accounts with Tax Invoice ( Booking-multiple Format ). Another example, Work Order – Covering letter, schedule of items, term and condition. ( Wo-Order print ) 
 1. Application Details 
 2. Booking 
 3. Agreement 
 4. Allotment 
 5. Offer of Possession 
 6. Possession 
 7. Proforma Invoice 
 8. Invoice 
 9. Credit Note 
 10. Reminder 
 11. Receipt 
 Default format setup 
 Document formats are created through Administration > Designer > Document Design page. Document formats are defined for each entry type. They can be further setup for a Business Unit and/or Type of Document for the Entry type. 
 Defaults are displayed automatically. Select from the list of formats to change printing format. 
 Default Format for Business unit and document type wise 
 Format can be created for a Business Unit and document type wise from Administration > Designer > Document Design page 
 Click on any where of Format Name column, it will open the window for selection of Business Unit and Document Type. 
 Set Business Unit and Document type from drop down list and click on Submit to save, Default value will be set to ‘Yes’. 
 At the time of printing, the previously set formats will come as default based on Business Unit and Document Type, however user can change the format if required. 
 Multiple print format selection : User can select multiple format for Printing 
 In Advance Search, the selected document remain tagged and can be used for sending Email/SMS after printing documents. The documents remain tagged until the user exits from the advance search screen.

title: Queue Management for Reports
text:
Queue Management for Reports 
 Some common features of Farvision 
 Queue Management for Reports 
 Queue management allows for processing of data in the background so that the user does not have to wait while data is being processed. Once the report or process is completed a notification will be provided that the job has been completed. It is important to use queues so that server utilization is not disturbed during peak working hours. 
 There are two types of queues 
 Queue Reports 
 Queue Processes 
 Notifications 
 Desktop notification will be shown after completion of job. Report can be downloaded from the notification alert. Queue Reports 
Some reports and bulk print format can be queued. There are two types of processes 
 ● Fire and forget - the queue is started on demand when the report has to be processed 
 ● Repeat every few minutes - any data which is added for the bulk processing will be processed, and checking for new data will be done on a predefined frequency. 
 Fire and forget 
 A job id is assigned against reports which are being queued under fire and forget. A notification will be sent to the user’s device once the report is ready. Reports which have been queued can only be printed from the Queue management console. Queued reports cannot be printed (either PDF or Excel) from the menu interface from which generation of report was started. 
 Example : Application detail register, Booking register, Invoice register and Receipt register, Indent register, Purchase order register, Goods receipt Note register and Purchase Bill register. Examples for Bulk Printing of documents are Invoice, Booking annexure, Applicant Ledger. 
 Repeat every few minutes 
Queues which repeat every few minutes are used for bulk printing of documents. No job id assigned as it is a continuous loop where more documents which are added for bulk processes are picked up. After receiving the notification, search Bulk Printing in the menu column and then for the relevant menu Item. 
 Download : Once the report is complete, it can be downloaded and saved locally. The report will be automatically deleted after downloading. Reports will be visible in the queue console until the reports are downloaded. Users are allowed to download their reports while admin users can download report of any user. 
 Delete : Pending and generated report can be deleted. If the status is pending, the delete button will stop the processing of the report. If the status is Complete, delete will physically remove the report and it will not be available, it is deleted from the server. 
 Status : Pending, In Process, Complete, Error, No record found are the status of the queued report. 
 Remarks : This column provides details of the status. Example, For In process, it will show start. 
 Desktop notification will be shown after completion of the job. Hide Downloaded : On select of the Hide Downloaded check box, all downloaded row items will be hidden and only those row items will be shown which are pending for download. Queue Process 
 Some reports a process has to be run before the report can be generated. 
 Example : Finance module cash flow report generated through process method and process report will be downloaded from queue console under the Process tab. 
 Property management invoice generated through bulk invoice menu after notification will be downloaded from the queue console. 
 © 
 Gamut Infosystems Limited

title: Data Import Process
text:
Data Import Process 
 Some common features of Farvision 
 Data Import Process 
 Data import allows data to be imported from excel sheets instead of entering through the interface. Data has to be entered in pre-defined excel sheets, checked for correctness and is then imported into Farvision. Data import is available for many masters and a few transactions, the process of importing is the same. Only the excel template is different in which data has to be entered. 
 Data import is normally used by first time users of Farvision, or if there is a huge volume. Bulk data can be inserted into Farvision and it saves time. Once your backlog is cleared, it is recommended to use the interface for day to day entry. Sometimes data import is also used where the number of rows in a document is very large, example a journal voucher with 200 lines. 
 There are four steps to be followed 
 ● Download Template 
 ● Upload Template 
 ● Validate Data 
 ● Import Data 
 DOWNLOAD TEMPLATE 
 Object: This is the master or transaction form for which the excel template has to be downloaded. 
 Nested Objects: Some forms which have to be imported have a lot of data, and have multiple excel worksheets in one excel template. These multiple worksheets normally correspond to tabs of the entry interface. Example, Account Head Import will have the worksheets for Ledger, Ledger Address, Ledger Communication, Ledger Contact, Bank Details, etc. 
 All these worksheets are linked to each other through a common field called Link Ref Code . The same value of this field in each row has to be entered under ImportLinkRefCode in the nested worksheets. In the Ledger worksheet Link Ref Code ‘1’ has details of Amar Singh, Link Ref Code ‘2’ has details of Amit Kumar Pal. In the Ledger Address worksheet, ImportLinkRefCode ‘1’ will contain address details of Amar Singh, Link Ref Code ‘2’ will contain address details of Amit Kumar Pal. The value given to the Link Ref Code and ImportLinkRefCode has to be the same so that data in the different worksheets can be associated with each other. 
 Download template : Download the template by clicking the Download button. An excel file will be downloaded on your local computer. Open the excel sheet. Enter the data in the excel sheet. 
 About the Excel Template 
 There may be one or more worksheets in which data has to or can be entered. Click on the different worksheets to enter data in them. Remember to use the same identifying value in all worksheets so that data between the different worksheets can be linked to each other. In case there is no data to be filled in the nested worksheets, leave it blank. Do not fill only the ImportLinkRefCode if no other data is available for entry in that sheet. In case there is a row in the main sheet but there is no associated data for that row in the linked sheets, skip that row number in the linked sheet. 
 Each excel template has an Info worksheet which will guide the user about the properties of the fields. 
 Sheet Name : Worksheet names are listed here. 
 Column Names : Fields available in all associated worksheets are listed here. Data has to be entered as rows, fields are the columns. 
 Properties : Fields can have the following properties 
 Is required: True - this is a mandatory field, has to be entered. 
 Is required: False - this is an optional field. 
 Max length: The maximum number of characters which can be entered in that field. 
 The following points have to be kept in mind while filling data in the prescribed excel sheet 
 Do not remove any columns or worksheets , even if there is no data to be entered in them. Format must be as per the original excel template downloaded. 
 Do not change any names, settings, alignment, formatting of fields, worksheet, or files . 
 Remove any hyperlinks from the data fields . Example Email. 
 Try to import records into batches of 100, 200 or 500 rows at a time. Import can be run multiple times. Data will keep on getting added in Farvision. 
 Fill all mandatory fields 
 Enter data in ImportLinkRefCode if data is there in the associated worksheets 
 Do not enter blank rows , especially at the end of the excel sheet 
 Wherever applicable, Debit and Credit amounts should tally . 
 Spelling of account heads, parent account, items, etc should be correct, i.e. match with the masters in Farvision 
 Wherever applicable, data in related sheets should tally with the data in the main sheet . Example, Receipt/Payment or Journals, the Adjustment Info amount for each party should tally with the amount in Ledger details for the same party. 
 Some tips 
 Clear cache and clear history of the browser, in case of unknown error 
 UPLOAD TEMPLATE 
 Upload the filled out excel Template to start the data uploading process. 
 Select File : Select the file in which data has been entered and has to be uploaded. 
 The template can be dragged and dropped or the same can be selected from its location. Click on the Drop files to upload panel. Select the file in which data has been entered and has to be uploaded. Click on the Upload button. Once the template has been uploaded, it will show the message Uploaded Successfully. Click on Next button to go to the data validation step. VALIDATE DATA Once the filled up excel has been uploaded, the data has to be validated from the template and click on Next 
 Process Queue : Click on the box so that the validation process can be routed through the Queue Management console. If the data volume is large, it is important to queue this process else the server will become very slow. 
 Validate Data : Click on the Start Validation button to start the validation process. 
 Status : While the data validation is ongoing, a status bar will show Validating Data, Please Wait. If the data validation is successful, it will show the status as Success. If data is not correct and has failed the validation process, it will show Error Found. 
 Result : In case the status is not successful, the reasons why validation has failed will be provided in this Excel file which can be downloaded. The file will have both data which has a problem and data which is correct. The data where there is a problem is highlighted in yellow. The problems with the data will be displayed in the Import Remarks column. In this example, HSN Id does not exist for Construction service in HSN Master. 
 In this example, Relationship should have Son or Wife, and the name Rakesh Kumar and Mahaveer Singh should have been entered in Relative Name respectively. 
 In this example, Postal code is a mandatory field that can’t be blank. 
 The validation routine has to be run repeatedly till there are no errors left. 
 Click on the Next button to go to the Import Data tab. 
 IMPORT DATA 
 Click on Start Import to start importing data from filled up excel template file into Farvision. On successful import, it will show the status as Success. Click on the Finish button. Data which has been imported can be checked in the respective Advanced Search for the transaction or master forms. 
 © 
 Gamut Infosystems Limited

 Prepaid Meter Configuration 
 What is a Prepaid Meter? 
 A 
 prepaid electricity meter lets you pay for your electricity before you 
 use it. 
 Unlike the usual 
 postpaid meters that bill you after you’ve used the electricity, prepaid 
 meters work on a pay-as-you-go system. You buy electricity credits and 
 load them onto the meter with a special token or code. The meter then 
 deducts the electricity you use from your available credit. When the credit 
 runs out, the power supply is automatically cut off until you add more 
 credits. 
 Steps to do Prepaid Meter Configuration 
 Create A Revenue Head 
 Before we set up the Prepaid Meter, 
 we need to create a Revenue Head first. 
 To do this, 
 navigate to Property Management> Setup> Charges> Revenue Head. 
 Once you click 
 on it, the following window will open. 
 Fill in the details as follows: 
 Alias: Enter 
 a code for the Revenue Head.

 Alternate Description: Enter any alternate description if available. 
 Revenue Head Type: Choose the revenue head type as ‘Advance 
 Recharge’. 
 Revenue Head Group: Choose the revenue head group. 
 Formula: Apply 
 formula, if available. 
 Against Revenue Head: NA 
 Parent Revenue Head: NA 
 Billed Revenue Head: NA 
 Calculation Basis: Choose the calculation basis as per 
 requirement. (e.g, Area Base, Lumpsum/Fixed) 
 Rounding: Select the preferred option from the list to round

 billed. 
 After filling in the details, the screen 
 should look like the following. 
 Tagging the Revenue Head with Business 
 Unit

 tag this Revenue Head with a Business Unit. 
 For that, navigate

 screen will be visible. 
 Once the Business 
 Unit is selected, click on Add New Row to open the following screen. 
 Fill in the following: 
 Revenue Head: Choose the proper Revenue Head against which the 
 Business Unit will be tagged. 
 Code: Auto 
 populated. 
 Formula: Insert 
 any formula, if available. 
 Once done, click on Finish. 
 Revenue Head Posting 
 Next, we will do Revenue Head Posting. 
 Navigate to Setup> Account Integration> 
 Revenue Head Posting. 
 The next screen will 
 appear where you need to enter the following details : 
 Posting Template: Tag the preferred 
 Posting Template. 
 Revenue Head: Tag the preferred Revenue 
 Head. 
 After filling in the above details, 
 click on Get Details to populate the Revenue Head. 
 Click on it and then Add New Row upon 
 which the following screen will open. 
 Fill in the following details: 
 Revenue Head Group: Auto populated. 
 Revenue Head: Auto populated. 
 Debit Posting 
 Parent Ledger: Tag the preferred Parent 
 Ledger. It should be same as ‘Sundry Debtors PMS’. 
 Credit Posting 
 Parent Ledger: Tag the preferred Parent 
 Ledger. 
 Earned Ledger: Tag the preferred Earned 
 Ledger, if available. 
 Account Head (Discount Posting): Tag 
 the preferred Account Head for any discounts, if available. 
 Effective From: Choose the date from 
 which the posting will start. 
 Once the above details are filled, click 
 on Save and Submit the Revenue Head Posting.

 Revenue Head.

 in this context and tag the appropriate HSN.

 isn’t going to be any HSN. Therefore, we will tag the HSN as ‘NGST’.

 to create Billing Terms.

 To setup billing terms, follow this 
 link: Billing 
 Terms

 from the list.

 list.

 Instrument Date: Auto populated. 
 Drawn On: The bank from which 
 the debit will be made. 
 Drawn On Branch: The branch of the bank from which the debit will 
 be made. 
 LPF Calculation Date: NA in case of Advance Recharge. 
 Debit Account: Choose the account from where the debit amount will 
 be deducted. 
 Show Late Payment Fee: NA for advance recharge 
 Auto Adjustment: NA for advance recharge. 
 Include Meter Recharge: Check this box after which the following screen 
 will appear. 
 The Bill Wise Adjustment tab would be 
 inactive once the Include Meter Recharge box is checked. 
 Narration : Enter any remarks, 
 if applicable. 
 POS: Enter

 After the above details are filled,

text:
MMC and Consumption Basis calculation & Setup Process 
 Tutorial" />
 MMC and 
 Consumption Basis calculation & Setup Process 
 Step1 : 
 Users need to create 3 Revenue Heads, one is for parent Revenue Head & 
 another 2 are for child Revenue Heads. Parent Revenue Head name is Electricity 
 Charges & Child Revenue Heads are Electricity Duty & Municipal 
 Tax. 
 Note: 
 Here the system should check which is high. If MMC is high, system will 
 generate the MMC amount else Consumed amount. 
 Step2 : 
 After Revenue Head creation users need to setup the Revenue Head wise 
 Prefix. 
 Step3 : 
 After Revenue Head wise Prefix setup Revenue Head Posting is required 
 for Parent Revenue Head. 
 Step4 : 
 After that users need to put the HSN code for Parent Revenue Head. 
 Step5 : 
 After that users need to set the billing frequency for Invoice creation 
 in Billing Term option for this Parent Revenue Head. 
 Step6 : 
 After Billing Frequency setup users need to save Unit Allocation from 
 unit allocation screen for this mentioned Parent Revenue Head. But before 
 this users need to create 2 Nos. of Units from Unit Master screen. 
 For 
 Case1 : 
 For 
 Case2 : 
 Here 
 are all the calculations based on Sanctioned Load of Meter. 
 1. 
 Before setting the Meter Master users need to concentrate on the following 
 points: 
 Note: There are three categories for Grid 
 billing. We can take an example to better understand and as well as we 
 will consider the following screenshots for the same. 
 i) Firstly 
 user will setup 0 – 100 units for slab -1. 
 (There 
 are 2 sub categories for slab -1, this is called MMC Calculation Factor 
 for Slab -1.) 
 a) 
 For 0 – 50 units it will be charged Rs. 2/units 
 b) 
 For 50 – 100 units it will be charged Rs. 2.05/units 
 ii) Secondly 
 user will setup 100 – 800 units for slab -2. 
 (There 
 are 4 sub categories for slab -2, this is called MMC Calculation Factor 
 for Slab -2.) 
 a) 
 For 0 – 150 units it will be charged Rs. 2.5/units 
 b) 
 For 150 – 250 units it will be charged Rs. 5.25/units 
 c) 
 For 251 – 500 units it will be charged Rs. 6.30/units 
 d) 
 For 501 – 800 units it will be charged Rs. 7.10/units 
 iii) Thirdly user will setup 800 units for slab 
 -3. 
 (There 
 are 1 sub categories for slab -3, this is called MMC Calculation Factor 
 for Slab -3.) 
 a) 
 For 0 – 999999 units it will be charged Rs. 7.10/units 
 Basically 
 we use “ Meter Master ” & “ Reading Slab Range Wise With MMC ” 
 screen from Farvision to complete this setup – Screenshots are given below 
 :- 
 2. Right 
 now users need to understand MMC Calculation Factor for Slab Wise. Now 
 users can take an example as per above “ Meter 
 Master ” & “ Reading Slab Range 
 Wise With MMC ” setup – 
 i) 
 MMC Calculation Factor for Slab -1: 
 For 
 First 2 KW rate will be Rs. 110/- and rest for Rs. 70/- 
 Example: 
 If 
 sanctioned load is 5 KW then the billable value will be calculated as 
 follows – 
 2 
 x 110 = Rs. 220/- 
 3 
 x 70 = Rs. 210/- 
 That 
 means Total Billable value is Rs. 430/- 
 ii) 
 MMC Calculation Factor for Slab -2: 
 For 
 First 2 KW rate will be Rs. 125/- and rest for Rs. 75/- 
 Example: 
 If 
 sanctioned load is 5 KW then the billable value will be calculated as 
 follows – 
 2 
 x 125 = Rs. 250/- 
 3 x 75 
 = Rs. 225/- 
 That 
 means Total Billable value is Rs. 475/- 
 iii) 
 MMC Calculation Factor for Slab -3: 
 For 
 First 2 KW rate will be Rs. 125/- and rest for Rs. 75/- 
 Example: 
 If 
 sanctioned load is 5 KW then the billable value will be calculated as 
 follows – 
 2 
 x 125 = Rs. 250/- 
 3 
 x 75 = Rs. 225/- 
 That 
 means Total Billable value is Rs. 475/- 
 Invoicing Part: 
 For Case 1: Where MMC charge is high 
 There are 
 another two revenue heads i.e. Electricity Duty @ 0.05/unit and Municipal 
 Tax @0.10/unit. If Billing is done on MMC basis, these charge heads are 
 not applicable.

 Calculation of Bill

 check here MMC for this slab i.e.,

 Total Amount 
 : Rs. 430/- 
 Note: 
 Based on above calculation system will check and found that MMC is higher 
 than consumed unit amount, so bill will be raised of Rs. 430/- 
 Reference Screenshots: 
 For Case 2: Where Consumed amount charge is high 
 There are 
 another two revenue head i.e. Electricity Duty @ 0.05/unit and Municipal

title: FAQ
text:
Frequently Asked Questions 
 Frequently 
 Asked Questions 
 Q: On 
 Account Adjustment: What could be the reason for the tax related problem 
 against a particular invoice number ? 
 Answer: The tax-related issue against 
 a specific invoice number is due to an incorrect State Code present 
 in the tax header for that invoice number. 
 Q: On Account Adjustment: 
 How to resolve an issue where the advance receipt voucher is not showing 
 in On Account Adjustment ? 
 Answer: To resolve the issue of 
 the advance receipt voucher not being visible in the On Account Adjustment, 
 verify if the advance receipt was processed through the finance module. 
 If it was, then it will not appear in the PMS. 
 Q: 
 Unit 
 Allocation: What could be the reason for the problem in data import/export 
 in Unit Allocation? 
 Answer: It 
 is an excel data problem. Fill the data in the correct format and 
 upload. 
 Q: Unit Allocation: 
 How to resolve an issue where the area type is not showing for the customer? 
 Answer: It 
 appears that the Area Type Configuration was not configured properly, 
 and the same may apply to the Unit Master screen. 
 Q: 
 Unit Allocation: What could be the reason for the Data not getting 
 imported in Unit Allocation ? 
 Answer: This 
 is due to blank spaces in the Excel file and the data not filled in 
 correctly. 
 Q: 
 Unit Allocation: Why is there a warning message at the 
 time of unit tagging in Unit Allocation ? 
 Answer: This 
 was because the Area Type Configurator was not set up properly. 
 Q: 
 Agreement: Why was Area shown ‘0’ at 
 the time of Agreement creation ? 
 Answer: It 
 was due to the improper setup in Area Type Configurator. 
 Q: 
 Invoice 
 Print: How to address a situation where the Customer address is incorrect 
 in bill compared to customer details ? 
 Answer: You 
 need to update the correct address in the ‘Customer Details’ section 
 and ensure that the correspondence address is updated from the same 
 screen. Additionally, make sure to check the ‘Update Billing’ checkbox. 
 Q: 
 Bulk invoice: What could be the reason for the error message 
 "Revenue Head Wise Prefix is not set up"? How can it be resolved 
 during bulk invoice generation ? 
 Answer: This 
 was because the Revenue Head Wise Prefix was not setup for the 
 particular Revenue Head. Kindly set up the Revenue Head Wise Prefix 
 properly. 
 Q: 
 Bulk invoice: How to resolve the warning 
 message: “Previous month bill was not generated” at the time of bulk invoice 
 generation ? 
 Answer: Users 
 should make note that while creating an invoice, month period should 
 be in sequential manner. 
 Q: 
 Bulk invoice: How to resolve 
 the error message: “Area type configurator is not set/set to 0” at the 
 time of bulk invoice generation ? 
 Answer: It 
 is due to the improper setup in Area Type Configurator. 
 Q: 
 Unit Master: 
 How can the area of unit be changed in Unit Master ? 
 Answer: If 
 the Unit is booked, changes to the area of the unit can be made through 
 the Revised Unit screen. If the unit is not booked, editing and changing 
 the area is possible. 
 Q: 
 Unit Master: 
 How 
 to resolve a situation when despite updating of the area of the unit, 
 the old area is displayed in Unit Master ? 
 Answer: The 
 area of the unit was updated from the "Revised Unit" screen, 
 so the old area will continue to be displayed in the Unit Master. 
 Q: 
 Billing 
 Term: How to resolve the Billing terms setup error: ‘Revenue Head is not 
 showing’ ? 
 Answer: Please 
 set up the Business Unit Revenue Head and verify whether Revenue Head 
 wise posting is enabled or not. 
 Q: 
 Invoice: Why is the Revenue head not displayed in invoice ? 
 Answer: Price 
 list needs to be created before generation of the invoices. 
 Q: 
 Meter Reading: 
 What could lead to an error while importing Reading ? 
 Answer: The 
 issue lies with the Excel sheet. Please download a new sheet and input 
 the data in the correct format. Once done, you can successfully upload 
 the sheet. 
 Q: 
 Adhoc Bill Entry: Adhoc 
 Bill Entry: What causes the incorrect calculation of the Net Amount in 
 Adhoc Bill entry ? 
 Answer: The 
 Net Amount appears to be incorrectly calculated as it mirrors the 
 Gross Amount in the Adhoc bill creation screen. However, upon submitting 
 the Adhoc bill, it gets saved accurately with the correct values for 
 both gross and net amounts 
 Q: 
 Adhoc Bill: How to resolve the inability to search from Unit 
 Alias in Adhoc Bill ? 
 Answer: If 
 you are creating an Adhoc Bill; choose from Customer name and not 
 from Unit Alias. 
 Q: 
 Invoice: What steps can be taken to address the problem of revenue 
 head rate and billing terms amount not loading in the Invoice Billing 
 Term tab ? 
 Answer: The 
 issue appears to stem from an improperly set price list. To resolve 
 this, users should ensure that the price list is configured correctly. 
 Q: 
 Money Receipt: How can the error Message ‘Revenue Head Posting 
 was not set’ shown 
 in Money Receipt entry be resolved ? 
 Answer: The 
 issue can be resolved through the creation of Debit and Credit posting 
 in Revenue Head Posting screen. 
 Q: 
 Bank Master: How to resolve the Document date format error when 
 saving Bank Master ? 
 Answer: Ensure 
 that Document date format is DD/MM/YYYY and not MM/DD/YYYY to resolve 
 this issue. 
 Q: 
 Invoice: Why is there an Abatement type error displayed in Invoice ? 
 Answer: The 
 error occurs because the Abatement checkbox was selected against the 
 goods category HSN. To resolve the error, please ensure that the Abatement 
 checkbox is not selected against the goods category HSN. 
 Q: 
 Update 
 GSTIN: What could be the reason behind the error message: “GSTIN OR Bill 
 already generated after this Effective Date” while trying to update GSTIN ? 
 Answer: The 
 error message appears due to attempting to update the GSTIN with a 
 date that falls on or after the invoice generation date. To resolve 
 this, provide a valid date that precedes the invoice generation date 
 and then proceed with the update. 
 Q: 
 Invoice: What could be the reason behind the error message: 
 “Previous month bill already has been generated” and what is the possible 
 solution ? 
 Answer: The 
 error message indicates that a bill for the previous month has already 
 been generated, causing the issue. To resolve this, delete the specific 
 invoice associated with the previous month, and then proceed to create 
 the invoice again.

 Gamut Infosystems Limited
